line.hollow-brood.a-beetle-s-husk-and: A beetle's husk... and their crates. They come this far from their glass roads?
line.hollow-brood.a-sap-spring-rest-here: A sap spring. Rest here if the road wears on you.
line.hollow-brood.an-old-broodkeepers-sh: An old broodkeepers' shrine... and its lantern still burns. Let the wisp sleep.
line.hollow-brood.but-nothing-down-there: ...but nothing down there moves the way it should.
line.hollow-brood.caplings-they-sleep-in: Caplings. They sleep in rings like that, and wake hungry.
line.hollow-brood.hold-still-brother-the: Hold still, brother. These webs stink.
line.hollow-brood.hollow-caches-my-queen: Hollow caches, my Queen. Their foragers hid what they could spare. Break them open.
line.hollow-brood.hornets-unless-you-wan: Hornets. Unless you want the whole nest on us, my Queen, let them be.
line.hollow-brood.it-sang-to-us-we: It sang to us... we drank... and it gave, and gave...
line.hollow-brood.let-us-fight-beside-yo: Let us fight beside you, my Queen. Let us put her to rest.
line.hollow-brood.light-the-queen-s-ligh: Light... the Queen's light. You found us.
line.hollow-brood.listen-digging-my-quee: Listen! Digging, my Queen. Behind the fallen tunnel, east of here.
line.hollow-brood.listen-someone-is-digg: Listen. Someone is digging behind that fallen tunnel.
line.hollow-brood.mother-ashka-drank-fir: Mother Ashka drank first, and drank the most. She does not know us now.
line.hollow-brood.mother-ashka-it-is-aur: Mother Ashka! It is Aurelith, of the Amber Court.
line.hollow-brood.mother-ashka-would-nev: Mother Ashka would never let her lights go dark.
line.hollow-brood.my-queen-my-brother-ke: My Queen... my brother Kesh took a patrol north-west, toward the old webs. They never came back.
line.hollow-brood.my-queen-the-hollow-s: My Queen! The Hollow's watch-lights went dark three nights ago.
line.hollow-brood.no-ant-will-drink-like: No ant will drink like this again. I swear it.
line.hollow-brood.queen-aurelith-you-cam: Queen Aurelith... you came. We prayed someone would.
line.hollow-brood.she-doesn-t-know-you: She doesn't know you, my Queen.
line.hollow-brood.so-loud-the-song-is: ...so loud... the song is so loud...
line.hollow-brood.split-open-as-if-somet: Split open... as if something grew inside it.
line.hollow-brood.stay-close-whatever-di: Stay close. Whatever did this is still out here.
line.hollow-brood.take-my-whistle-it-has: Take my whistle. It has called us home through worse.
line.hollow-brood.the-hollow-its-nest-st: The Hollow. Its nest still glows...
line.hollow-brood.then-come-all-of-you: Then come. All of you who can.
line.hollow-brood.then-i-will-help-her: Then I will help her sleep.
line.hollow-brood.then-walk-home-with-us: Then walk home with us, Kesh. We go to the Hollow.
line.hollow-brood.then-we-go-and-ask: Then we go and ask them why.
line.hollow-brood.they-drank-from-the-de: They drank from the deep pool. Then they stopped sleeping.
line.hollow-brood.this-was-one-of-ashka: This was one of Ashka's. Look at its shell.
line.hollow-brood.those-are-hollow-ants-: Those are Hollow ants drinking, my Queen. Or they were.
line.hollow-brood.tiv-tiv-i-knew-you: Tiv? Tiv! I knew you'd come.
line.hollow-brood.we-sent-scouts-not-one: We sent scouts. Not one came back.
line.hollow-brood.we-tracked-the-hollow-: We tracked the Hollow's foragers in here, my Queen. The webs were waiting.
objective.hollow-brood.ashka.description: Go down into the Hollow and put Mother Ashka to rest
objective.hollow-brood.ashka.title: Mother Ashka
objective.hollow-brood.patrol.descriptio: Find Kesh's patrol in the old webs to the north-west
objective.hollow-brood.patrol.title: The lost patrol
objective.hollow-brood.reach.description: Follow the root path north-east to the Hollow
objective.hollow-brood.reach.title: The Hollow
objective.hollow-brood.survivors.descrip: Break through the fallen tunnel east of the rim and find who is digging
objective.hollow-brood.survivors.title: Survivors
